seo_title: Serverless Cloud Antivirus API for SMBs | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Protect your web forms from malware. We integrate a Serverless Cloud API for file isolation and scanning tailored for small businesses and freelancers.
author_pitch: I have seen dozens of agencies lose days of work due to an infected file disguised as a simple client PDF. Centralizing security in the cloud via a serverless approach is the only way to shield your business without skyrocketing infrastructure costs.
title: The client's disguised virus: Serverless Cloud Antivirus API to shield your website uploads
body:
Did you know that a simple PDF attached to your quote form can contain malware capable of hijacking your entire corporate server?

Small agencies, design studios, and freelancers receive dozens of files from clients every day: logos, texts, blueprints, or payment receipts. You trust them because you want to close the sale, but allowing anyone to upload files directly to your hosting without filtering is a digital Russian roulette. A single infected script can steal your database credentials or infect your office devices in seconds, completely halting your operations.

The trap of relying on traditional hosting

Most small businesses believe that their hosting antivirus or a WordPress plugin is enough to stop these threats. However, modern attackers obfuscate malicious code within seemingly harmless files that basic extension filters completely ignore. Storing and processing the file on the same server as your website before validating it is opening the door to the enemy inside your own home. In cybersecurity for SMBs, delegating filtering to your shared hosting is a lethal negligence.

Our solution: Serverless Cloud Scanning Vault

At LANZAESTUDIO, we design and integrate a Serverless Cloud API architecture that acts as an impassable sanitary barrier for your digital platform.

  1. Temporary Sandbox Isolation: The file uploaded by the user never touches your web server; it is routed directly to an isolated and secure container in the cloud.
  2. Automated Multi-Engine Analysis: A serverless function runs a deep scan within milliseconds, searching for malware signatures and known viruses.
  3. Disinfection and Cryptographic Cleansing: If the file is safe, it is digitally signed and transferred to your database or final storage.
  4. Real-Time Threat Destruction: Any suspicious element is destroyed on the spot at the Edge, automatically blocking the attacker's IP address.

The Real Impact on Operational Security

  • Zero Ransomware Risks: Shield your SMB software and your team's computers against trojans and data hijacking.
  • No Fixed License Fees: Being a serverless infrastructure, you only pay pennies per scanned file, avoiding abusive monthly fees.
  • B2B Reputation Protection: Prevent yourself from involuntarily becoming a computer virus vector for your own commercial clients.
